label: Varangians
blurb: Norse warriors of the eastern road: reckless, hard-hitting, lightly armoured.
lore: Traders, river crews and mercenaries from the Baltic to Constantinople; some served the emperor in the Varangian Guard.
Painted round shields, Dane axes and yew bows; a seeress whose curses unsettle the bravest.
